visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young female presenter with long dark hair, wearing a white knitted spaghetti strap tank top and a grey mini skirt, stands in an indoor studio. She smiles and speaks enthusiastically while gesturing with her hands against a white brick wall background featuring a deer painting and a green plant. (2) Close-up on a wooden table surface where a pair of hands with painted nails carefully peels back a white adhesive paper cover from a flat white package, gradually revealing a brown accordion-pleated fabric accessory hidden inside. (3) The host holds up the long brown pleated knitted strap, stretching it slightly to demonstrate its elastic texture and soft material. She continues to address the camera with an expressive face, standing in the same studio environment. (4) Extreme close-up of the brown knitted material being pulled apart by hands. The visual focuses on the vertical pleats and the depth of the knit, showing how the fabric expands under tension and retains its shape. (5) The presenter holds the brown strap vertically next to her leg and then compares it to a long brown sock she is wearing on her right foot to highlight their visual similarity in texture and color. (6) Top-down view of hands on the wooden table attaching the brown pleated strap to a geometric patterned blue/grey handbag, showing how the strap can be looped around the bag's existing handles. (7) The presenter models the brown strap as a stylish handbag handle and then as a crossbody accessory. A close-up follows where hands slide a light blue smartphone into the horizontal slit of the pleated fabric. (8) The host holds up two fingers gesturing 'two' versions. A graphic overlay appears showing multiple color variants of the 'iPhone Pocket' with their respective prices of NT$4,990 for short and NT$7,790 for long versions. (9) The host leans into the frame for a close-up secret sharing gesture, followed by a screenshot of an Apple Watch price. She concludes by holding the brown product and pointing down to the bottom of the frame.
